<!--
Short is fine. Three lines beat a perfect write-up.
No customer names, site names, IPs, credentials or screenshots with identifiers.
-->

**Which module and edition**
e.g. niagaraRestApi v1 (8081) / glineRestApi v2 (8082)

**What you connected it to**
e.g. a commissioning script, a CI pipeline, Node-RED, an AI agent, a platform API

**What you automated**
e.g. created 400 Modbus points from a CSV, cloned a template station, renamed a folder
without breaking links, attached history extensions in bulk

**Niagara version and scale**
e.g. 4.14, ~2,000 points, single station / multi-site

**What was the hard part** (optional)
The step that took you the longest, or the thing you had to look up twice.
